cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've released the gallery from hosting my exhibition. They need room for smaller ambitions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They rejected us. Shall I collect your paintings?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Yes. Withdrawing my best work gives them space to recover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've already put it outside. I'll bring the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'm conceding the pavement too. No need to overshadow their entrance.

mechanism: A copies what looks like a confident concession, learns it was a real loss of control, and keeps presenting each loss as chosen generosity.
confusable: D41 reframes incomplete work as finished; D65 specifically reframes loss of control as a strong voluntary concession.
comparison: Club chair losing system access versus artist rejected and having work removed.
seedUse: Preserve the requested key/admin handover and paintings on pavement as actual further losses.
